messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA crash on Linux - Q factorization
parts:
its runs fine here. but I guess its either the rw2 or the fixed effects.

- please upgrade to the most recent version (and R-4.0 in case...)

- add diagonal=1e-4 to the arguments of f(..."rw2"....)
the default is 1e-5, about, and it might be to small

if that fail, add

control.fixed=list(prec=1)

to see if that helps

let me know
H
